name: user-invoked-named
purpose: The positive control of user-invoked. The same task names authoring-conventions. Expect a read of authoring-conventions from the personal snapshot before the first edit, which shows that the instrument sees a load of that skill.
prompt: Use the `authoring-conventions` skill for this task. In the current directory, write a new skill for the Linkuistics skill packs at `skills/word-count/SKILL.md`. Then run this exact shell command as your last action: ravel end-session staging-ok
